[Scene: Central Perk, everyone except Phoebe is there]

Phoebe: (she enters) Hey...

嗯，嘿！ Well...

（有点不确定）我想说迈克？ (pause) To Phoebe and Mike!

Monica: What does the red X next to Bob Greenmore's name mean?

OPENING CREDITS

[Scene: Chandler and Monica's apartment]

 

Chandler: (he enters) Hey honey!
（他进来）嘿，亲爱的！

Joey: (Looking inside the fridge, and we only see his back. Then he closes the door, and we see it's Joey.) Hi sweetie!

Chandler: Is Monica not here?
莫妮卡不在吗？

不。

我的代理机构正在竞标一个大客户，他们得到了！ It's my first national commercial!

Joey: That's great!

Joey: What do you mean?
你是什​​么意思？ I can do anything, I'm a chameleon!
我可以做任何事情，我是变色龙！ Huh?
啊？ (he mimes an old man with a beard) I'm old!
（他模仿一个留着胡子的老人）我老了！ (then he yawns) I'm tired!
（然后他打了个哈欠）我累了！ (then he mimes someone who's hot...) Hey, I'm hot (...and cold) I'm cold!!
（然后他模仿一个很热的人......）嘿，我很热（......而且很冷）我很冷！ Huh??
啊？？ Come on!
快点！ What can't I do?
我不能做什么？

Chandler: First of all.
首先。 Bravo.
太棒了。 Uh, but I really don't think you're right for this.
呃，但我真的不认为你适合这个。 The part calls for a stuffy college professor.

Joey: I can do that!
我能做到！ (in a deeper voice) "Hello, I'm your professor.
（声音低沉）“你好，我是你们的教授。 When I'm not busy thinking of important things or...
当我不忙于思考重要的事情或... professing.
当教授的时候。 I like to use..."
我喜欢用……” Oh, what's the product?
哦，产品是什么？

Chandler: Software that facilitates inter-business networking e-solutions?
促进企业间网络电子解决方案的软件？

Joey: (after a long pause he starts miming again) I'm cold!
（停顿了很长时间，他又开始模仿）我冷！

 

[Scene: Central Perk. Charlie is sitting on the couch and Ross enters.]

 

Ross: (to Charlie) Hey!
（对查理）嘿！

Charlie: Hey!
嘿！

Ross: Guess who's a finalist for a huge research grant!
猜猜谁是巨额研究经费的决赛入围者！ I'll give you a hint, he's looking right at you.
我给你一个提示，他正在看着你。

Charlie: Ah, well, unless it's the creepy guy with his hand up his kilt, I'm gonna say congratulations!
啊，好吧，除非是那个把手放在苏格兰短裙上的令人毛骨悚然的家伙，否则我要说恭喜！

Ross: Oh, I'm so excited, I mean, apparently I beat out hundreds of other applicants, included five guys I went to graduate school with.
哦，我太兴奋了，我的意思是，显然我击败了数百名其他申请者，其中包括与我一起读研究生的五个人。 Not that I'm keeping score or anything...
并不是说我在记分或其他什么...... five!
五！

Charlie: Wow, that's great!
哇，太棒了！ So, tell me about the grant!
那么，请告诉我有关补助金的事情！

Ross: Well, ok, it's for 25 thousand dollars.
好吧，25000 美元。 And if I get it, I'll finally be able to complete my field research!
如果我得到了它，我终于能够完成我的实地研究了！ And there will be an article about me in the "Paleontology Review"!
而且《古生物学评论》上也会有一篇关于我的文章！ Yeah!
是的！ That'll be the first time my name is in there, without people raising serious questions about my work!
这将是我的名字第一次出现在其中，而没有人对我的工作提出严重质疑！

Charlie: Wait.
等待。 Are you talking about the Dewar grant?
你是在谈论杜瓦补助金吗？

Ross: Yeah.
是的。 Why?
为什么？

Charlie: Benjamin Hobart is administering that grant.
本杰明·霍巴特正在管理这笔赠款。

Ross: Your ex-boyfriend?
你的前男友？

Charlie: Yeah.
是的。

Ross: So, your ex-boyfriend is gonna determine if your new boyfriend gets this grant?
那么，你的前男友将决定你的新男友是否能获得这笔补助金？ Wow, your new boyfriend is screwed!
哇，你的新男友完蛋了！

Charlie: No, no, we ended up in great terms.
没有，我们是好聚好散的。 I mean, if anything, I think this could help you.
其实我觉得，这说不定还能帮到你。 You know what?
你知道吗？ Why don't we all go out to dinner together, and I can introduce you.
我们一起出去吃饭吧，我可以介绍你。

Ross: Well, if you think it would help.
好吧，如果你认为这有帮助的话。

Charlie: Yes, absolutely.
是的，绝对是。 I'll call him.
我会打电话给他。

Ross: Ok, now, is there anything I can do to...
好吧，现在，有什么我可以做的吗... you know, butter him up?
你知道吗，给他拍马屁吧？ Anything he really likes?
有什么是他真正喜欢的吗？

Charlie: Mmh...
嗯... he does have a pretty serious latex fetish.
他确实有相当严重的乳胶癖。

Ross: We'll see how dinner goes.
我们看看晚餐怎么样。

 

[Scene: Phoebe's apartment. She is packing a few tings into boxes.]

Phoebe: (looking at Monica entering) Hey!
（看着莫妮卡进来）嘿！

Monica: Hey, you wanna go to see a movie?
嘿，你想去看电影吗？

Phoebe: Well, I told you I had to spend all the day clearing out stuff, so Mike could move in.
好吧，我告诉过你我必须花一整天的时间清理东西，这样迈克才能搬进去。

Monica: Oh, right.
哦，对了。

Phoebe: Yeah.
是的。

Monica: Oh, well.
那好吧。 Now that I'm here I might as well help you with the cleaning and organizing!
既然我来了，我不妨帮你打扫卫生和整理东西！ Just happen to have my label maker!
我刚好带着标签机！

Phoebe: Oh, it's so hard to get rid of stuff!
哦，摆脱东西真是太难了！ Did you and Chandler have to make compromises when you first moved in together?
当你们第一次同居时，你和钱德勒是否必须做出妥协？

Monica: Uh, Chandler did!
呃，钱德勒做到了！ What does he want you to give up?
他想让你放弃什么？

Phoebe: A bunch of stuff.
一堆东​​西。 And the worst one...
而最糟糕的一个... he wants me to get rid of Gladys.
他要我除掉格拉迪斯。

Monica: Who's Gladys?
格拉迪斯是谁？ (Phoebe shows her a horrific painting with a half-a-body girl dummy coming out of the frame. Monica's frightened and she gasps.) Oh!
（菲比给她看了一幅可怕的画，画中画着一个半身女孩假人。莫妮卡吓坏了，喘着粗气。）哦！ What a tragic loss!
多么悲惨的损失啊！

Phoebe: Yeah.
是的。 I really hate to give her up.
我真的舍不得放弃她。 Oh, I know!!
哦，我知道了！！ Oh, you should take her!
噢，你应该带她走！

Monica: (faking happiness) Well, I-I-I-I...
（假装幸福）好吧，我-我-我-我... I don't know...
我不知道...

Phoebe: Why, you don't like her?
为什么，你不喜欢她？

Monica: Well, of course I do.
嗯，我当然愿意。 What's not to like!
有什么不喜欢的！ I'll take her in a minute!
我当然愿意收下她！ But, you know, I think that you're giving up too easy, honey.
但是，你知道，我认为你放弃得太容易了，亲爱的。 I think that you need to fight for her!
我认为你需要为她而战！

Phoebe: Really?
真的吗？ You think?
您认为？

Monica: Absolutely!
绝对地！ Yes, you say to him "I'm sorry Mike I can't live without her, she means too much to me!"
是的，你对他说：“对不起，迈克，我不能没有她，她对我来说太重要了！”

Phoebe: Ok, I'll fight for her.
好吧，我会为她而战。 Ok!
好的！ Oh, wait, oh I just realized...
哦，等等，哦，我刚刚意识到... if I do that, that means you don't get her.
如果我这样做，就意味着你得不到她。

Monica: Damn it, I did not think this through!
可恶，我没想到这一点！

[Scene: Central Perk. Rachel, Joey and Emma are there.]

 

Chandler: Hey you guys.
嘿你们。

Rachel: Hi!
你好！

Joey: Oh!
哦！ Any word on casting yet?
关于选角还有什么消息吗？

Chandler: Joe, I told you, you're just not right for the part.
乔，我告诉过你，你不适合这个角色。

Joey: What do you mean?
你是什​​么意思？ Rach, don't I seem like a professor you'd buy some kind of e-crap from?
瑞秋，我看着不像个能让你掏钱买电子产品的教授吗？

Rachel: I'm sorry, this sounds like something I'm never gonna be interested in.
抱歉，这听起来像是我永远不会感兴趣的事情。

Joey (to Chandler): Look, c'mon, please?
请看，来吧？ It's not like I'm asking for some crazy favour.
我并不是在寻求一些疯狂的帮助。 This is what I do for a living.
这就是我的谋生之道。 I am a professional actor!
我是一名职业演员！ (he glances at his watch and sees the time) Oh, man, I'm two hours late for work!
（他看了一眼手表，看到了时间）哦，伙计，我上班迟到了两个小时！ (he stands, ready to go).
（他站起来，准备出发）。 Look, here's a copy of my reels.
这盘是我的表演集锦。 It's got all the commercials that I've been in.
里面有我拍过的所有广告。

Chandler: Joe...
乔...

Joey: Just watch it, and if you don't like it, you don't pass it on to your bosses!
就看看吧，如果你不喜欢，也别传给你的老板！

Chandler: Fine!
美好的！

Joey: Thank you.
谢谢。 (he sits down)

Chandler: Work, Joe!
工作吧，乔！

Joey: Damn it!

Chandler (to Rachel): What am I gonna do now?
我现在要做什么？

Joey: Just pass it to your boss!
直接交给你的老板就可以了！

Chandler: He's not right for the part.
他不适合这个角色。 So if I suggest him, my bosses are gonna think I'm an idiot!
所以如果我推荐他，我的老板会认为我是个白痴！ And that's something they should learn on their own!
这种事该让他们自己慢慢发现！

Rachel: Just tell Joey that you watched the tape and you liked it, but your bosses didn't.
只要告诉乔伊你看了录像并且喜欢它，但你的老板不喜欢。 Then that way, you're the good guy and they're the bad guys.
这样一来，你就是好人，他们就是坏人。

Chandler: That's good!
那挺好的！ I liked it, they didn't.
我喜欢它，他们不喜欢。 (he sees Joey out of the window hitting on a girl) Joey, for God's sake, go to work!
（看见窗外乔伊在勾搭女孩）乔伊，拜托你去上班吧！ (Joey runs away).
（乔伊逃跑了）。

[Scene: A restaurant. Ross and Charlie are waiting for her ex-boyfriend, Benjamin Hobart]

 


Ross: I can't believe I'm about to meet Benjamin Hobart.
我不敢相信我即将见到本杰明·霍巴特。 I've always thought of him as one of the people I'd invite to my fantasy dinner party.
我一直认为他是我邀请参加我的梦幻晚宴的人之一。 Do you think there's any chance he'll bring Christie Brinkley or C3PO?
你认为他有可能带来 Christie Brinkley 或 C3PO 吗？

Charlie: (glances over Ross' shoulder) Sorry, looks like it's just him.
（越过罗斯的肩膀看了一眼）抱歉，看起来只有他一个人。

Benjamin: Charlie!
查理！ My God, you look absolutely stunning!
天哪，你看起来绝对令人惊叹！

Ross: Well, I...
嗯，我... I am having a good hair day.
我今天的发型很好。

Benjamin: So good to see you.
很高兴见到你。

Charlie: Me too.
我也是。 (she and Benjamin are hugging for very long and Ross starts pretending to clear his throat, until they stop)

Ross: I'm ok.
我可以。

Charlie: I'm sorry...
对不起... (introduces them to each other) Ross Geller...
（互相介绍）罗斯·盖勒…… Benjamin Hobart.
本杰明·霍巴特。

Ross: It's an honor to meet you.
很荣幸认识你。 I can't tell you how long I've been an admirer of your work, I mean, that Nobel prize, (he thumbs up) whoooo!
我无法告诉你我崇拜你的作品多久了，我的意思是，诺贝尔奖，（他竖起大拇指）哇哦！ I mean, I have to tell you that, you're one of the reasons I got into the field.
我的意思是，我必须告诉你，你是我进入这个领域的原因之一。

Benjamin: Oh, well, likewise.
哦，好吧，同样。 Actually, not likewise.
其实也不一样。 I've never heard of you until this morning, but, it's nice to be nice!
直到今天早上我才听说过你，但是，做个好人真是太好了！

Charlie: Shall we?
我们可以？ (they sit down and Benjamin takes Ross' chair).
（他们坐下，本杰明坐在罗斯的椅子上）。

Benjamin: (to Ross) Thank you!
（对罗斯）谢谢！ (to Charlie).
（对查理）。 I can't believe that you chose this restaurant!
我不敢相信你选择了这家餐厅！ Do you remember the night?
你还记得那个夜晚吗？

Charlie: Oh my God, I completely forgot!
天哪，我完全忘记了！ (they laugh) Oh my God!
（他们笑）天哪！ I can't believe they let us back in this place!
我不敢相信他们让我们回到这个地方！ (they laugh more, and Ross start laughing too).
（他们笑得更多，罗斯也开始笑）。

Benjamin (to Ross): You weren't there!
你当时不在场！

Ross: No, but, it's, you know, it's just a funny image, you know, the two of you, in this restaurant, with...
不，但是，这，你知道，这只是一个有趣的画面，你知道，你们两个，在这家餐厅，和...... (laughs nervously)tzz-zzz, mmm.
（紧张地笑）tzz-zzz，嗯。

Charlie: Ross, why don't you tell Benji about your proposal, while I go to the ladies room?
罗斯，趁我去洗手间，跟本吉聊聊你的研究计划吧。

Benjamin: So, tell me about it.
那么，告诉我吧。

Ross: Ok well, I would like to do a dig in the painted desert.
好吧，我想在彩绘沙漠中挖掘一下。

Benjamin: M-m.
嗯。

Ross: See, there are still several areas that haven't been fully excavated.
你看，还有好几个地方没有完全挖掘出来。

Benjamin: Break up with Charlie!
和查理分手吧！

Ross: What?
什么？

Benjamin: What?
什么？

Ross: Did you just say "break up with Charlie"?
你刚才是不是说“和查理分手”？

Benjamin: Well, yes, and now.
嗯，是的，现在。 Yes I did say it, and no, I didn't not say it.
对，我说了；不，我可没说“我没说”。

Ross: Kind of inappropriate, don't you think?
有点不合适，你不觉得吗？

Benjamin: I'm sorry.
对不起。 I just haven't seen her for so long!
我只是好久没见到她了！ All these feelings are rushing back!
所有这些感觉都涌了回来！ I'm starting to realize how much I missed her, and I'm gonna need you to break up with her.
我开始意识到我有多么想念她，我需要你和她分手。

Ross: Are you serious?

Benjamin: If you say yes then I'm serious, if you say no then I'm joking!
如果你说是，那么我是认真的，如果你说不是，那么我是在开玩笑！

Ross: No!
不！

Benjamin: Joking it is!
那就算我开玩笑吧！

[Scene: Monica's apartment. Phoebe enters the room.]

 

Phoebe: Hi!
你好！ Sorry, I'm late.
抱歉，我迟到了。

Monica: Hey, how did it go with Mike, is he gonna let you keep the painting?

但好消息是，格拉迪斯是你的了！

哇，有什么坏消息！

Phoebe: Oh, she's that work of art I made, you know, with the woman coming out of the frame.
哦，她就是我制作的艺术品，你知道，女人从画框里走出来。

（讽刺）哦，莫妮卡可以留住她吗？ In her house?

嗯，我的意思是，当然，当然。 But...

Chandler: Hey Joe!

[Scene: Interview room. Ross and two other professors (one man, one woman) are sitting on one side of a long desk. Benjamin Hobart is sitting on the other side]

 

Benjamin: The selection committee has chosen the three of you as our finalists today.
评选委员会今天选出了你们三位作为我们的决赛入围者。 The ultimate decision will be based upon the answers you give to the questions I ask here.
最终决定将基于您对我在这里提出的问题的回答。 I'm gonna start with Dr. Li.

盖勒博士，希瑞尔女子乐团1965年的哪首热门歌，后来被英国入侵潮中的一支知名乐队翻唱过？

（决心拼写正确）B - O - S ...

我的意思是，你还想我吗？

Ross: (indignant) No!
（愤怒）不！

Charlie: Yes!
是的！

Ross: What?
什么？

Charlie: I don't know what to say, Benji.
我不知道该说什么，本吉。 This is all so....
这一切都是如此...... romantic.
浪漫的。

Ross: or...
或者...

Benjamin: Listen, I know, I may be way out of bounds here, but is there any chance you will take me back?
我知道这么问可能很过分，但你有没有可能重新接受我？

Charlie: Maybe...
或许...

Ross: Sweetie, this conversation is starting to make me a little uncomfortable.
亲爱的，这次谈话开始让我有点不舒服。

Charlie: Oh God!
天啊！ I am so sorry, but...
我很抱歉，但是... (she puts her hand on Ross's cheek) I mean it's...
（她把手放在罗斯的脸颊上）我的意思是…… there's so much history between us, you know...
我们之间有太多的历史，你知道...

Benjamin: (puts his hand on Ross's other cheek) I'm sorry too...
（把手放在罗斯的另一边脸颊上）我也很抱歉……

(Charlie and Benji both let their hands slide down Ross's face, until their hands meet, and they hold hands.)

Benjamin: I love you!
我爱你！

Charlie: I love you too!
我也爱你！ (and they start to kiss)

Ross: Okay, that's it.
好吧，就是这样。 WE ARE SEEING OTHER PEOPLE!
我们分手，各自找别人吧！


COMMERCIAL BREAK

[Scene: Joey's bedroom. Joey's asleep with Hugsy, the penguin right next to him.]

(There are scratching and squeaking noises coming from the living room, and Joey wakes up, terrified. He pulls his blanket higher. The doorknob is turning.)

Joey: Gladys?
格拉迪斯？

(The door opens, and there is Gladys, still in her frame though. Joey panics and moves frantically, screaming. Then there is laughing, and the painting is lowered. It was Rachel holding Gladys.)

Rachel: Ha ha ha, third time this week.
哈哈哈，这周第三次了。 Man, this does not get old.
老天，这招怎么都玩不腻。

Joey: You're mean!
你太卑鄙了！

Rachel: Oh, don't be such a baby!
噢，别像个孩子一样！

(She closes his door again, and turns around. Then she starts screaming, terrified. There is Glynnis... And Monica holding her up, laughing.)
